summary: Baiya International Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting that Mr. Bin Tan resigned as Chief Operating Officer effective June 6, 2026. The filing states the resignation was not due to any disagreement with the company regarding operations, policies, or practices. No further terms, compensation, or replacement details are provided. The filing is a routine disclosure of an executive departure, but because it is a COO resignation (not a forced CEO/CFO/board exit), and the event is itself the subject of the filing, it qualifies as a management change. Confidence is medium as the departure is voluntary and lacks conflict, reducing materiality. What to watch: whether a successor is announced, or if this signals broader organizational shifts.
